status_message: Independent scan completed: 16 candidates reviewed; 0 execution-ready, 4 watch, 12 screened out.
portfolio_note: Independent scan: 16 candidates (8 tokens, 8 equities). No execution-ready idea; four remain conditional WATCH candidates and twelve were screened out. Evidence gaps are not presented as economic failures.

evidence.methodology: Screened eight tokens and eight natural-resource equities against published-history exclusions, portfolio concentration, valuation compression, dilution or supply, holder value capture, catalyst quality, and primary-source support. WATCH means follow-up is required, not a buy signal.

ideas.name: Pendle
ideas.snapshot: US$2.34 at 2026-09-18 01:16 UTC; US$406m market cap / US$658m FDV; -54.8% over one year; 61.7% of reported total supply circulating.
ideas.thesis: Official documentation describes sPENDLE fee-linked buybacks and lower terminal emissions, making holder economics worth measuring rather than assuming.
ideas.risk: Not execution-ready: current fee-dollar run-rate, venue-specific executable slippage and a dated rerating catalyst were not independently verified. sPENDLE also has withdrawal constraints, including a 14-day standard withdrawal or a 5% instant-withdrawal fee.
ideas.trigger: Upgrade only after verifying a current fee run-rate, the latest distribution, and executable slippage at the intended size; require a dated catalyst before any action.
